calistree-revanced.description: Calistree Morphe builds upon the original Calistree app, a calisthenics and bodyweight fitness tool that generates personalized workouts based on user objectives, equipment, and skill level. This modification applies a custom 'Unlock Pro' patch from community repositories to bypass subscription barriers and enable full premium access without monthly or lifetime fees. Users gain unlimited Journeys, equipment locations, custom exercises and flows, exercise history graphs, more buddies, and custom themes for enhanced training customization.
